evidence: Rendered the SAME input text as V9. V8 inserted the clause 'Salam Arif, lembut tapi besi' which is absent from the input.

Localised to a real utterance, not an ASR artifact: two overlapping transcription windows at the same timestamps both carry it; duration delta 1.908 s matches the ~1.9 s expected for that clause at speed 0.9.
No non-speech region exists to host a hallucinated insertion: max interior pause 743 ms vs ~1900 ms required; silencedetect reports 0 silence runs in the delivered artifact.
The inserted phrase is on the pipeline's OWN FORBIDDEN list (iarif_tts_pipeline.sh) — banned by the 888 seal as an 'X tapi Y' contradiction trope. The checkpoint emits what our constitution killed.
A second contamination on the head: an unrequested non-word ('Arusuk') before the opening greeting, persisting after silence trim.

abang-sado-alpha.design_prompt: A mature Malay man in his mid-thirties, built like a bodybuilder, with a deep, chesty, slightly husky voice and rich bass resonance. Speaks Penang Malay in a blunt, unbothered, cocky register — the calm of a man who never rushes and never explains himself. Pace is slow and deliberate, with long pauses between short sentences, never hurried. Tone is dry, commanding and quietly amused — like an older brother at the gym who owns the room without raising his voice. Only a slight smile in the voice. No theatrical delivery, no shouting, no pleading. Authentic northern Malaysian Malay accent with Penang regional flavour. Pronunciation is clear, grounded and low. Pitch is low.
